label: PtetR* (pRAB)
note: PtetR* (pRAB): the tetR promoter of the pRAB Tet vectors, annotated in pRAB11 (JN635500) as 'pR* w/o tetO'. It overlaps a modified copy of the Tn10 tet control region: its 3' half is J01830 1545-1574 read on the tetR strand, with two substitutions (J01830 1552 C>T and 1554 C>A on the tetA strand) that turn the Tn10 sequence there into the consensus -10 TATAAT; its -35, TTGACA, lies in vector sequence upstream of the Tn10 homology. The same two changes fall in the Tn10 operator O1 that the region overlaps, which the record marks 'w/o tetO'. The -35 and -10 below are predicted by the catalog's criteria (tools/promoter_boxes.py), not mapped; no transcription start is mapped for this promoter. On the opposite strand the same bases read as the -35 and operator of a tetA-type promoter with two changes, which is why partial tet-promoter hits used to land here.
